text: Space: 1999, a British science fiction television series, consisted of 48 episodes that aired from 1975 to 1977. The first series, comprising 24 episodes commonly known as "Year One," premiered in the UK on 4 September 1975, although the first episode was produced as early as 1973. Different ITV franchises broadcast the episodes in varying sequences. The airdates listed below correspond to the order of their first UK broadcast, which differs from the broadcast order in Australia, where the series initially aired in July 1975.
